Product.title: Precision Capture
paragraphs: True-to-Life Facial Contours, Hues & Proportions – Photorealistic Detail Rendering.

Product.title: 3D Facial Analysis
paragraphs: Five Key Areas (Nasal & Forehead, Facial Shape, Lips & Chin, Proportions, Aesthetic Triangles) with 17 Parameters.

Product.title: AI-Driven Smile Design
paragraphs: Generating personalized aesthetic treatment plans that enable patient involvement in outcome visualization, while facilitating streamlined clinician-patient discussions.

Product.title: Dental Innovation
paragraphs: Combining 3D facial models with intraoral scans and CT data enables accurate reconstruction of craniofacial anatomy, enhancing treatment planning for orthodontics, prosthodontics, implants and orthognathic surgery.
